crystal_phase.Pt/C: metallic phases with a face-centered-cubic (fcc) structure

Proof in the paper: The (2 2 0) planes of the Pt-based metallic phases were compared. According to the Scherrer equation, the average particle sizes of Pt/Ti4O7, PtIr/Ti4O7, and Pt/C were measured as 4.1, 3.6, and 4.2 nm, respectively. Moreover, the peak position of (2 2 0) for PtIr/Ti4O7 was positively shifted, demonstrating the alloy formation of PtIr on Ti4O7.
